scope: Verification index for the 180-component source patch applied to the uploaded LMX tree.
authoritative_count_rule: Read final whole-composition build/test counts from the linked dated report; do not sum standalone CTest counts or reuse older composition totals.

previous_verified_phase.scope: Complete merged composition immediately before the HDF5/PnetCDF/netCDF/libxml2 expansion and MAT73 follow-up.

production_dialect: C99 with -pedantic-errors for the selected profiles; individual adapters record exact changes and exclusions.

mpi_execution.single_rank_mpi_io: PASS in HDF5 and PnetCDF focused tests; netCDF dispatch and independent CDF5 cross-reading have separate reports.
mpi_execution.multi_rank: NOT_RUN: host environment blocks multi-rank MPI initialization; retained test code supports later execution on a suitable platform.
mpi_execution.environment: Observed one-rank tests use UCX_TLS=self, UCX_VFS_ENABLE=n and HWLOC_COMPONENTS=-linux on the prepared MPICH host. These are test-host settings, not portable library defaults.

not_claimed: Target CPU performance or peak RAM
Final linked LMX kernel or L3 wrapper execution
Complete XML/DAP or scientific-format conformance corpora
source_license_limits: Inherited Mint/afan NOASSERTION records stay explicit and are not relicensed by this patch.

data_rescue_previous_phase.verification: Re-read damaged file, RS correction, header bounds, decompression, CRC and full byte equality
